---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and why is it hard or impossible today?
Describe the concrete scenario (e.g. "embedding Knowledge in a B2B
knowledge tool, I need …").

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If it affects
a public API (crate type, FFI function, REST endpoint), sketch the shape.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you have considered, and why they fall short.

## Scope

- Which surface does this touch? <!-- crate, ffi/napi, Go gateway, docs -->
- Is this a breaking change to a public API?
- Does it fit the project's on-device-first, privacy-first direction?
  (See the [roadmap](../../docs/product/roadmap.md).)

## Additional context

Add any other context, references, or prior art here.
